Description: Participants listened to a looping audio consisting of one melodic phrase followed by six lyrical phrases, repeated three times.
Instructions: Close your eyes and internally sing along with the lyrical phrases, synchronizing your inner voice with the rhythm and melody of the audio.
StimulusDescription: The audio is a 2-minute and 13-second composition with a repeating structure: one melodic introduction followed by six lyrical phrases, looped three times.
CognitiveDescription: Internal auditory rehearsal and musical imagery.
CognitiveBehavioralInstructions: Stay still, keep your eyes closed, and imagine singing the lyrics silently in sync with the audio.
